entries.started_basis: Dinis's word of 6 November 2026 (about 04:00 UTC by the guidance; the session's clock read 03:42 when its key was made): a librarian, as on the SG/Send project, that maps everything, and a search to go to all the pages (board/guidance/2026-11-06-design-and-passes.md, sections 2 and 6).
